## Added

- Per-page document inspection metadata in `--page-count` output, including `width_px`, `height_px`, and `contains_images`.
- Per-page extraction metadata for PDF and PNG cutting output, including rendered pixel dimensions and image-presence detection.
- PNG width-based rendering via `--scale-width-px`, preserving aspect ratio for the generated image.

## Changed

- Page dimension metadata is now reported in pixels instead of millimeters.
- PNG JSON output now reports the active sizing mode through either `scale` or `scale_width_px`.

## Fixed

- Image detection now inspects nested form/XObject page objects, not just top-level page objects.
- Concatenated PDF output now includes `page_info` metadata for each included source page.
